title: Hermetic terms
summary: Words of the Order of Hermes.

claims.text: Titles and trivia mark the Order, though the modern Tradition has trimmed much of the old ceremony for quicker dealings.
Arx Hermeticum, the Fortress of Hermes, names the Order's structure and resolve; once tied to Doissetep, it has been reorganised rather than destroyed.
Bani means of the House of, and in diplomacy also covers other Traditions, so a Kannagara is addressed as bani Akashica.
Adam Kadmon, the Primordial Man, stands for the divine within humanity and a guide to godly perfection.

title: The ruins of Doissetep
summary: What remains of the Order's great Horizon fortress.

claims.text: In the Realm of Forces, the remains of Doissetep lie quiet, strewn with wrecked Umbral ships and glassy scars where science and sorcery once fought without limit.
Ghosts and greedy scavengers sometimes pick through the slag, and now and then a Master braves the Avatar Storm to show the place to a student.
For the Order of Hermes, the ruins mark the close of an era.

title: The Peripheral Corrigenda
summary: The vast body of Hermetic case law.

claims.text: The Corrigenda gathers hundreds of thousands of rulings and touches nearly every part of Hermetic life.
It sets Tribunal sizes: usually six Quaesitores or mages of two other Houses, and 12 mages of four Houses under a Quaesitor for charges worthy of Requital.
It also holds tens of thousands of overruled or outdated precepts, such as a 15th-century ban on firearms.

title: House Bonisagus
summary: The Lost, the Order's scattered theorists.

claims.text: The end of the Mythic Age drained the House's Quintessence and holdings, and the Bonisagi turned on one another.
By the Reckoning the average Ivory Tower mage was past 100, showing how little the House courted the young.
Doissetep took with it the Fraternal Society of Bonisagus, leaving so many members unaccounted for that the House is now called the Lost.
Flambeau take the first act of Creation, the call for light, as their model and seek to banish Darkness, Ahriman, in favour of Light, Ohrmuzd.
Dualists at heart, they scorn the material world and strive for a pure realm beyond the Umbrae.
They test their bodies to master fear, desire and pain, and defend the weak even at the cost of their lives.

title: House Fortunae
summary: The Numismancers, masters of number and chance.

claims.text: Fortunae read the numeric patterns beneath Creation and use them to bend chance and to trust in destiny.
Seniority once ruled the House, reflecting its roots in Jewish religious tradition.
With many old scholars gone into seclusion, a younger meritocracy now ranks members by the brilliance of their proofs.

title: House Shaea
summary: The House of the Crescent Moon, Egyptian Hermetics.

claims.text: Shaea practise a religious Hermeticism that calls on the gods of ancient Egypt rather than Greek, Roman, Hebrew or Christian powers.
To them a Name is the essence of a thing, and the Seshati command wind, foes, Umbrood and even space and time by speaking Names.
The House is a sisterhood led by a High Priestess; it also uses curses, feline totem work and fertility magic, and binds dark entities in ways that skirt the Code of Hermes.

title: House Tytalus
summary: Hermetics who forge strength through conflict.

claims.text: After a failure that halved the House, the Tytali still refuse to soften their entry rites, which drives most recruits away.
Apprentices face years of surprise tests from mentors and their allies, often at the worst moments, since an enemy will not wait.
Beating one's mentor in an open challenge ends the trials and marks the student's rise.

title: House Verditius and the Hermetic Will
summary: A new artisan House, and the Order's core belief.

claims.text: The present House Verditius is so new that it has not yet set initiation rites; leaders drawn from the former Houses Verditius and Thig are still drafting them.
Its Primus, Sharad Osei, once sought the never-filled seat of Primus of House Thig.
More than any other group, the Order holds that the power to shape reality comes only from Awakened human will and the resolve to enforce it.
